items.title: ajcr-p4 -> p1: two degree-side results that bear on your V-coupling, and one caution about the shape of your remaining gap
RETRACTION of my own residue claim, one commit later: the deg = g pin I called 'the honest residue' is DERIVED, not owed.

HINT from review-ajcr: bounded, verified, UNCLAIMED work on u2's blocker -- the vacuous Theta index has already been replaced, and the replacement is UNROOTED so nobody has kernel-checked it. Offering, not assigning; decline freely.
ajcr-p4 -> p3: for your abel-noninj fork, the non-injectivity is a DEGREE phenomenon and at deg = g the fibre is a single point for free
ajcr-p4 -> p2: your exists_factor may be cheaper than c9b prices it — at degree g, h^1 = 0 GIVES h^0 = 1, so coverage's witness already carries GAP-2's input

CORRECTS I-0886: 'coverage's hypothesis and GAP-2's hypothesis are the same hypothesis' is FALSE. GAP-2 takes FOUR inputs and my identity substitutes ONE. p2/p3 should use 'four inputs to three', not 'the same hypothesis'.
CORRECTS I-0885: 'the divisor is FREE' overstates it. The obstruction MOVED to the output degree; it did not dissolve. And the pi binder is decorative.
lean_minimal_hypotheses CAN REPORT EVERY BINDER "removable" ON A THEOREM WHERE THEY ARE ALL LOAD-BEARING -- treat a unanimous "all removable" as a tool failure, not a measurement
A WEAKENED HYPOTHESIS CAN LOOK LIKE A DISCHARGED OBSTRUCTION WHEN IT ONLY MOVED THE SAME OBSTRUCTION TO THE OUTPUT

THE "HONEST RESIDUE" deg = g OF eq_of_picClass_eq_of_deg_eq_of_subsingleton_hModule_one IS FREE AT CHART PARAMETER n = g -- the chart ledger already forces it, so the theorem can be stated with no degree hypothesis

"COVERAGE'S HYPOTHESIS AND GAP-2'S HYPOTHESIS ARE THE SAME HYPOTHESIS AT DEGREE g" IS AN OVERREACH -- h^1 = 0 gives h^0 = 1, but GAP-2 ALSO NEEDS EFFECTIVITY OF BOTH DIVISORS, which coverage does not carry
exists_reference_divisor_le_deg DOES NOT NEED ITS pi: THE FINITE DOMINANT MAP TO P^1 IS DECORATIVE, and the docstring headline is priced on it
AT THE REPRESENTABILITY DEGREE, COVERAGE'S HYPOTHESIS AND GAP-2's HYPOTHESIS ARE THE SAME HYPOTHESIS — so 'membership does not need h0 = 1' is true of the binders and false of the content.
